transcript.content: Hello.
Haan bolo.

Good evening, Rohan! Main Bluepoint Homes se Ananya bol rahi hoon. Aapne 99acres par Bluepoint Skyline Residences, Kharadi ke liye enquiry ki thi, toh kya ye do minute baat karne ke liye sahi time hai?

Thank you! Aapne 2 BHK ke liye interest dikhaya tha, toh kya aap ye apne family ke liye dekh rahe hain ya phir investment ke liye?

Haan, budget ek crore hai. Thoda stretch kar sakta hoon, lekin 1.05 crore se zyada nahi.
I understand. Bluepoint Skyline Residences mein 2 BHK ka range ₹92 lakh se ₹1.04 crore tak hai, toh ye aapke budget mein fit ho jayega. Aap kab tak move in karne ka plan kar rahe hain?

Main aapki chinta samajh sakti hoon. Bluepoint Skyline Residences ka possession December 2027 ka hai, jo MahaRERA ke saath registered hai. Theek hai, Saturday dekh lete hain.
Ek second, main check karti hoon. Saturday ke liye hamare paas ye do slots available hain: 11 AM ya phir 4 PM. Aapko kaunsa time suit karega?<turn|>
